individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of pseudocoloured micrographs, not a plot.

Panel B shows scatter/line kinetic traces (and insets of averaged responses as scatter points with error bars), which are exempt plot types where individual points are either the data itself or overlaying them would be unreadable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrographs, not a plot.

The insets in panel B display average early time point responses with visible error bars, but the caption only describes what the insets represent, not what the error bars quantify (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
